sources.finding: Temporal variables, including neural traces from different planes, were resampled to center-plane acquisition times. Actual running field is beh.runSpeed.
The paper describes 400 ms cortical scans and 1.2 second analysis bins (Figure1 and accompanying text).
Code uses bin2d(Ff,4,2) for db.nplanes==10, otherwise bin2d(Ff,3,2). All four files declare nplanes=12.

decision: Mean matching nonoverlapping triples from sample zero for activity and speed; nominal1.2 seconds per bin.
verified: Author-documented resampling and factor-three analysis precedent; supplied lengths verified in completed validation.
unverified: No per-session acquisition timestamps or within-file acquisition-run boundaries found in inspected metadata/documentation.
continuity_policy: Use released within-file sample order, never join files. Unknown internal acquisition boundaries cannot be excluded from bins/windows; no inferred gaps from activity or fine-timescale causality claims.
